description: This file contains functions related to the system upgrade process for a Linux-based embedded device, including image checking, partition handling, EFI system partition updates, and overall upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and compatibility of a system upgrade image by comparing partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the appropriate partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates the EFI System Partition (ESP) with EFI boot files from a new image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function orchestrating partition updates, image flashing, and EFI updates.
